aiPack.metaTitle: HLDeck AI Pack: local AI on your own GPU with one command (waitlist)
aiPack.metaDescription: Planned paid add-on for the free HLDeck installer: Ollama, Open WebUI and ComfyUI on an NVIDIA GPU with one command, plus a playbook with numbers measured on a real RTX 3090. Join the list.
aiPack.lead: Ollama, Open WebUI and ComfyUI on your own NVIDIA GPU with one command, plus a playbook with the numbers we measured on a real RTX 3090. Leave your email and we will tell you when it is ready.
aiPack.statusText: The pack is not built yet. The guides below are the manual version of it and they are free. We build the pack if enough people join this list, so joining is a vote, not a payment.
aiPack.plan1Text: One command sets up Ollama, Open WebUI and ComfyUI with the GPU already working, at pinned versions. Everything is written as plain files you can read, change and keep without hldeck.
aiPack.plan2Title: A GPU check before anything is installed
aiPack.plan2Text: The installer first checks the NVIDIA driver and, in a Proxmox LXC, the passthrough, and tells you what is missing instead of failing halfway.
aiPack.plan3Title: Guard rails we learned the hard way
aiPack.plan3Text: A memory limit for ComfyUI and a timer that frees idle VRAM. An uncapped video job once froze our whole host, and several AI services have to share one card.
aiPack.plan4Text: Our measurements in one place: VRAM and speed per model, sharing one GPU between containers, and the context-size trap that breaks local coding agents. All numbers come from one machine with an RTX 3090 and the playbook says so.
aiPack.numbersText: These come from our own free guides. The pack turns the same setup into one command.
aiPack.number1: gpt-oss:20b in Ollama: about 16.5 GB of VRAM at a 32k context, 122 to 125 tokens per second.
aiPack.number2: SDXL in ComfyUI at 1024x1024, 25 steps: 8 to 9 seconds per image, about 7 GB of VRAM.
aiPack.number3: Coding agents on the local model, four tasks: OpenCode passed 4 (one retry), aider 3, Codex CLI 1.
aiPack.number4: The base of it all: passing one NVIDIA GPU to several Proxmox LXC containers.
aiPack.priceText: Planned price: $19, paid once. No subscription. The HLDeck installer, its three current profiles and every guide on this site stay free.
aiPack.fit1: You have a PC or server with an NVIDIA GPU and Debian, Ubuntu or a Proxmox LXC container.
aiPack.fit2: You want a private chat assistant and image generation at home without a weekend of setup.
aiPack.fit3: Not for you yet: AMD and Intel GPUs and machines without a GPU. We have not tested them, so the pack will not claim to support them.
aiPack.formTitle: Tell me when it is ready
aiPack.formText: You get one email when the pack is out, and the HomelabDeck newsletter with new apps and guides (a few emails a month at most). We send a confirmation link first. One click to unsubscribe.
aiPack.ctaText: We are planning a paid AI Pack for the free HLDeck installer: Ollama, Open WebUI and ComfyUI on your NVIDIA GPU with one command, plus a playbook with our RTX 3090 numbers.
